title: Normalized finite-level realizations and scalar projections before singleton extension
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], l a prime distinct from D.p, O a commutative ring and t an element. Suppose all positive quotient rings O/(t)^(n+1) are finite and killed by powers of l. Let f:X→Y be separated and finite type between finite-type D.k-schemes, with no separatedness condition on Y, and c a compactification. Fix S:StrictEtaleCompactSupport O t c [def-per-strict-etale-system-interfaces]. There exist normalized realizations [def-pur-etale-brown-projection-realization] at X, c.Z and Y, normalized proper and open image realizations, and an open extension comparison whose mate is the inverse image-realization comparison. Pasting the open extension and proper image comparisons gives the level compact-support comparison. There are open and proper scalar projection isomorphisms, fixed by their displayed mates of S.openDerived.derivedTensor and S.properDerived.derivedTensor. Their pasted projection inverse, transported through the normalized realizations, equals the published compactScalarMap. This conclusion contains no singleton extension comparison or singleton invertibility assertion.

source.place: Zheng, Construction 4.1 (printed p. 21), Constructions 5.14–5.15 and Lemma 5.16 (printed pp. 34–35); normalization through constant-scalar restriction, exact localization and the published scalar adjunctions. Stacks Tags 03CY, 06YY and 07A4.

proof.text: Apply the single-scheme realization theorem at X, c.Z and Y, and the single-image comparison theorem at each proper and open coefficient level.

Construct the open extension comparison as the inverse mate of the normalized inverse-image comparison. The realization functors are equivalences, so the inverse mate is an isomorphism. The inverse law for mateEquiv gives its required mate equation.

Obtain the open and proper scalar projections from their single-factor transport theorems; install hfinite n for the proper factor. These give both displayed mate equations and the local scalar squares.

Expand the two pasted isomorphisms into their component maps. Naturality of the proper image realization moves the inverse open projection through it. Apply the local open square, then the local proper square. Naturality of scalarMate at the open comparison changes the result into the published proper mate followed by proper image of openIso, namely compactScalarMap. Precompose with the inverse scalar realization and the scalar image of inverse levelComparison; cancel the two isomorphism pairs. This proves the final transport equation on every derived object.

proof_origin.place: Zheng Construction 4.1 and Constructions 5.14–5.15, Lemma 5.16. Four strictly local comparison obligations; open inverse-mate construction and proper/open naturality pasting proved in Lean by M6.

theorem etaleBrownLevelComparisons
    (D : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (O : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing O] (t : O)
    (hfinite : ∀ n : ℕ, Finite (strictEtaleBrownRing O t n))
    (htorsion : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a : ℕ, (l ^ a : strictEtaleBrownRing O t n) = 0)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f) (S : StrictEtaleCompactSupport O t c) :
    ∃ (realizationX : StrictEtaleBrownRealization O t X S.PX)
      (realizationZ : StrictEtaleBrownRealization O t c.Z S.PZ)
      (realizationY : StrictEtaleBrownRealization O t Y S.PY)
      (properRealization : ∀ n, StrictEtaleBrownImageRealization O t c.g n
    S.properImage (S.properDerived.level n) realizationZ realizationY)
      (openRealization : ∀ n, StrictEtaleBrownImageRealization O t c.i n
    S.openImage (S.openDerived.level n) realizationX realizationZ)
      (openComparison : ∀ n, S.levelDerivedOpen n ⋙ realizationZ.derived n ≅
    realizationX.derived n ⋙
      (Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (strictEtaleBrownRing O t n)) c.i).mapDerivedCategory)
      (openProjection : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n),
    (S.PX.scalar h).derived ⋙ S.levelDerivedOpen m ≅
      S.levelDerivedOpen n ⋙ (S.PZ.scalar h).derived)
      (properProjection : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n),
    (S.PZ.scalar h).derived ⋙ (S.properDerived.level m).direct ≅
      (S.properDerived.level n).direct ⋙ (S.PY.scalar h).derived),
      (∀ n,
    (mateEquiv (S.levelDerivedOpenAdjunction n)
      (((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (strictEtaleBrownRing O t n))
        c.i).mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction).ofNatIsoRight
          (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (strictEtaleBrownRing O t n))
            c.i).rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory)
      (.mk _ _ _ _ (openComparison n).inv)).natTrans = (openRealization n).inverse.inv) ∧
      (∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n),
    (mateEquiv (S.levelDerivedOpenAdjunction n) (S.levelDerivedOpenAdjunction m)
      (.mk _ _ _ _ (openProjection h).hom)).natTrans = (S.openDerived.derivedTensor h).inv) ∧
      (∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n),
    (properProjection h).inv =
      (mateEquiv (S.properDerived.level n).adjunction (S.properDerived.level m).adjunction
        (.mk _ _ _ _ (S.properDerived.derivedTensor h).hom)).natTrans) ∧
      (let levelComparison (n : ℕ) :
          S.levelFunctor n ⋙ realizationY.derived n ≅
            realizationX.derived n ⋙ Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (strictEtaleBrownRing O t n)) c :=
        Functor.associator _ _ _ ≪≫ isoWhiskerLeft _ (properRealization n).right ≪≫
          (Functor.associator _ _ _).symm ≪≫ isoWhiskerRight (openComparison n) _ ≪≫
          Functor.associator _ _ _
      let projection {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
          (S.PX.scalar h).derived ⋙ S.levelFunctor m ≅
            S.levelFunctor n ⋙ (S.PY.scalar h).derived :=
        (Functor.associator _ _ _).symm ≪≫
          isoWhiskerRight (openProjection h) _ ≪≫ Functor.associator _ _ _ ≪≫
          isoWhiskerLeft _ (properProjection h) ≪≫ (Functor.associator _ _ _).symm
      ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n)
    (P : DerivedCategory (strictEtaleLevel X O t n)),
    (Etale.scalarExtension (strictEtaleBrownRingMap O t h) Y).map
        ((levelComparison n).inv.app P) ≫
      (realizationY.scalar h).inv.app ((S.levelFunctor n).obj P) ≫
      (realizationY.derived m).map ((projection h).inv.app P) ≫
      (levelComparison m).hom.app ((S.PX.scalar h).derived.obj P) ≫
      (Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (strictEtaleBrownRing O t m)) c).map
          ((realizationX.scalar h).hom.app P) =
    (Etale.compactScalarMap (strictEtaleBrownRingMap O t h) c).app
      ((realizationX.derived n).obj P))
